steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Media production involves three stages: pre-production (planning, scripting, storyboarding, casting, financing), production (filming, recording, creating), and post-production (editing, effects, sound mixing, grading).

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Financing: media products are funded through various models — studio investment, licence fee (BBC), advertising, subscription, crowdfunding, and government grants.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Distribution is how media products reach audiences — cinema release, broadcast, streaming, physical media, print, and digital download. Each channel has different economics and audience reach.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Marketing strategies include: trailers, posters, social media campaigns, press junkets, premiere events, viral marketing, influencer partnerships, and merchandising.

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Q: Describe the three stages of media production. | Q: How has streaming changed media distribution? | Q: Evaluate the impact of digital technology on media production.
